label: scope5-at-scale
description: Authored at-scale demonstration (not corpus-derived): once past the default threshold (3), many verification_hardening findings accumulate as plan-review debt WITHOUT growing the round count. Rounds 1-2 fix plan_correctness findings (C1, C2) to reach the threshold. Rounds 3-4 each co-emit two first-occurrence hardening findings (C3/C4, then C6/C7) that bank as deferred debt on arrival AND one plan_correctness finding (C5, then C8) that forces the round. Round 5 co-emits only two hardening findings (C9, C10), which bank and land the review accepted-with-debt. Across the negotiation SIX hardening asks (C3, C4, C6, C7, C9, C10) convert to debt, yet the round count stays bounded at 5 — every forced revision round was driven by a plan_correctness finding, never by a hardening ask. If each hardening ask had forced its own round, the negotiation would have run at least 6 additional rounds.
